script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg.
Let ability be a smart-weighted move of executer.
If ability is the id of the move labelled "poisonbreath_poison" on executer, then executer uses ability with its cast time followed by [{abilityId: ability}, {abilityTag: "poisonbreath_status", abilityOptions: {skipAttackMotion: true}, conditions: {anyCanHit: true}}].
Otherwise, executer uses ability.
